en.name: Mo3ta

en.name: Cutaway
en.line: A concept digital twin of a hospital in the browser, with simulated beds, rooms and equipment, in English or Arabic.

r.text: A white model; colour only ever means data
React Three Fiber and TypeScript; the day simulated in a Web Worker
Whole hospital at 72–90 fps on an integrated GPU
